exampleMix.reason: Use one well-documented game for the event and patch distinction. The test-case door is an authored example, kept separate from claims about Splatoon.

01.focus: Actual countdown, changed assigned weapon and fog.

02.focus: Real wave shows one play sequence. Diagram shows three hypothetical histories reaching one door.

03.focus: Show a distinct part of the wave, then keep the regression definition on the test matrix.

04.focus: Continue to another situation, then diagram the version, saved state and steps needed to reproduce a report.

05.focus: Patch summary is the evidence for both changes. Use ordinary play as continuity before the two documented changes appear.

06.focus: Closing new wave: fight ends, fog lifts, next assignment appears.
